summary: Tuesday: Markets erase Iran war losses on deal optimism. PPI March +0.5% vs +1.1% est. — biggest downside surprise in months. Nasdaq 10-day win streak. JPM +13% profit, Citi +42% net income crush Q1. BE +24% leads hydrogen/quantum rally. Tomorrow: NFLX, TSM, ABT, PEP. Good Friday closes week early. VIX 18.36 — firmly risk-on.

risks.label: Iran Talks Fragile — Reversal Risk
risks.detail: Trump signaled openness to Iran talks, erasing last week's war losses. But talks are preliminary — any breakdown reignites $100+ oil and VIX 25+. Binary risk: diplomacy succeeds or fails hard. No middle ground.

risks.label: Nasdaq 10-Day Streak — Mean Reversion
risks.detail: Nasdaq has rallied 10 consecutive sessions — historically, 65% of such streaks see pullback within 5 days. Not a sell signal, but tighten stops on momentum trades. Extended positioning creates reversal risk.

risks.label: Section 122 Tariff Cliff (Mid-July)
risks.detail: Post-SCOTUS 10-15% tariffs under Section 122 expire in ~90 days. Market hasn't priced renewal vs expiry. Average effective tariff ~12%. Consumer staples and China-exposed retailers vulnerable.

risks.label: Oil Still Elevated ($91-96)
risks.detail: WTI $91.66, Brent $95.68. Iran deal hopes cap upside but $4 Brent premium signals residual geopolitical risk. Oil above $90 is still a consumer tax and inflation headwind.

risks.label: Crypto Decoupled From Equity Rally
risks.detail: BTC flat at $74.4K while equities surge. ETH/BTC ratio at multi-year lows (0.0314). SOL -2.1%. Crypto ignoring risk-on mood — potential liquidity or structural issue.

risks.label: China Q1 GDP This Week
risks.detail: Consensus +5.0% YoY. Miss below 4.5% triggers PBOC easing speculation and EEM selloff. Critical for copper, iron ore, and Hang Seng.

events.label: Retail Sales March (Today 8:30 ET)
events.detail: Consensus +0.6% MoM. After soft PPI, a weak retail number cements June rate cut expectations. Strong number keeps 'hot economy' alive.

events.label: BAC & GS Earnings (Today BMO)
events.detail: After JPM and Citi crushed Q1, bar is high for Bank of America and Goldman Sachs. Any miss will be punished given elevated expectations.

events.label: NFLX Earnings (Wed AMC)
events.detail: Netflix reports after close Wednesday. EPS est $0.77. Streaming profitability and ad-tier growth are key metrics for tech earnings momentum.

events.label: TSM Earnings (Wed BMO)
events.detail: Taiwan Semi reports before open Wednesday. EPS est $3.29. AI chip demand trajectory is THE metric — validates or challenges entire Nasdaq rally thesis.

events.label: PEP & ABT Earnings (Wed BMO)
events.detail: Consumer staples bellwethers. PepsiCo EPS est $1.55, Abbott $1.15. Consumer spending health check.

events.label: Good Friday — Markets Closed (Apr 18)
events.detail: Shortened trading week. All action compressed into Mon-Thu. Position squaring likely Thursday afternoon.

events.label: FOMC April 28-29 Preview
events.detail: Expected hold at 3.50-3.75%. Soft PPI shifts odds toward June cut. Watch Fed speakers this week for PPI reaction commentary.

opportunities.label: TSM — Pre-Earnings Positioning
opportunities.detail: TSM consolidating near highs ahead of Wednesday BMO report. AI chip demand intact. Entry $188-192, Stop $178, TP1 $205, TP2 $220. R:R 1:1.8.

opportunities.label: JBLU — Iran Deal Oil Relief
opportunities.detail: Airlines surged on Iran optimism — JBLU +16.9%. If talks progress, oil to $85 is massively accretive. Pullback entry $7.80-8.00, TP $9-10.50. Binary risk — half size.

opportunities.label: BE — Hydrogen/Fuel Cell Breakout
opportunities.detail: Bloom Energy +24% on JPM upgrade to $231 and Jefferies upgrade. Hydrogen economy theme surging (green hydrogen +22%). Momentum play with elevated risk.

opportunities.label: IONQ/QBTS — Quantum Computing Wave
opportunities.detail: IONQ +20%, QBTS +16%. Quantum computing is the hottest thematic. Speculative but momentum is strong. Trail stops tightly.

opportunities.label: 10Y Below 4.30% — Growth Tailwind
opportunities.detail: 10Y yield dropped to 4.256% (-4.1 bps) on PPI surprise. If yields break 4.20%, growth stocks get another leg. TLT +0.53%.

opportunities.label: Scanner: CAT #1 (Score 91)
opportunities.detail: Caterpillar top pick — infrastructure + defense tailwinds. Entry $345.50, TP1 $362, TP2 $378. R:R 1:2.0.

opportunities.label: Scanner: TSM/AMAT Semis Duo (90)
opportunities.detail: TSMC + Applied Materials — AI capex cycle. TSMC earnings Wed catalyst. Both score 90.

regimes.label: Regime: Risk-On (VIX 18.36)
regimes.detail: VIX component scores perfect 1.0. Composite regime score 0.40 = firmly risk-on. SPX component 0.62 bullish. But credit (0.49) and bonds (0.37) are more cautious — typical of early-cycle recovery from geopolitical shocks.

regimes.label: Inflation: Disinflation Reasserted
regimes.detail: PPI March +0.5% vs +1.1% est. — biggest downside surprise in months. 10Y yield -4.1 bps. Bond market believes disinflation intact despite tariffs. Next data point: CPI May 13.

regimes.label: Earnings Season: Strong Start
regimes.detail: JPM profit +13% to $16.5B, Citi net income +42%. Bank earnings crushing estimates. Sets positive tone for broader earnings season. 60.6% of stocks positive — healthy breadth.

regimes.label: Crypto: Range-Bound Decoupled
regimes.detail: BTC $74.4K holding but not participating in equity rally. ETH/BTC at multi-year lows. SOL weakest major alt. Crypto needs its own catalyst — equity risk-on isn't enough.
